about: BYLD Capital Finance Ltd is an RBI-registered, non-deposit-taking Base Layer NBFC. Incorporated in 1994, it was formerly named TRC Financial Services and Avasara Finance; Jupiter Capital acquired control in FY18, and the company adopted its present name in May 2026. [1]
